UpdateSourceArgs: -c 'set -eu; cd "$1"; if [ -f .runner ]; then echo "Runner already registered"; exit 0; fi; if [ -z "$2" ] || [ -z "$3" ]; then echo "Set GitHub URL and registration token in AMP settings, then run Update again"; exit 1; fi; if [ ! -x ./config.sh ]; then chmod +x ./config.sh; fi; ./config.sh --unattended --replace --url "$2" --token "$3" --name "$4" --labels "$5";' _ '{{$FullBaseDir}}' '{{RunnerURL}}' '{{RunnerToken}}' '{{RunnerName}}' '{{RunnerLabels}}'
